Ivy Chen: Kicking off Willowbrook onboarding. Need to lock stakeholders, SSO, initial 0-30 plan, and renewal signals. Propose Mon 4/12 10:00am PT for a 30m kickoff. Agenda: owners, SSO/network, data scope, success metrics.

Rafael Ortiz: Monday 10 works. Quick question: Will Willowbrook be using Private (VPC) or Hosted?

Maya Singh (Willowbrook): Private VPC please. Compliance team needs SOC2 review. We'll start with 10k knowledge base docs + 2k support tickets.

Olivia Park: I'll run enablement + prompt workshop. Can someone confirm SSO type?

Maya Singh (Willowbrook): Okta SAML. I'll drop admin contact and metadata before EOD Friday.

Ivy Chen: Draft owner list:
- Willowbrook exec: Maya Singh
- Willowbrook infra: Harish Patel (confirm)
- Redwood CSM: Ivy Chen
- Redwood Solutions: Olivia Park (enablement)
- Redwood Infra: Rafael Ortiz (Private deploy)

Ivy Chen: Proposed success criteria (feedback welcome):
- Endpoint reachable and authenticated from Willowbrook VPC
- Initial data ingest (12k docs) indexed and searchable within 48h
- Pilot user satisfaction >= 4/5 after week 2
- No critical compliance findings on initial PHI/SOC2 scan

Maya Singh (Willowbrook): Add adoption metric: 25 DAUs during pilot week.

Rafael Ortiz: Network notes: Need allowlist + test SAML metadata to validate. Will draft small Dedicated reserve for first 30 days and share capacity suggestion after sample QPS.

Olivia Park: I'll prepare a short 90-min enablement + eval session for week 2 and a prompt pack.

Ivy Chen: Blockers to track now: SOC2 exceptions (Maya), allowlist + SAML metadata (Maya), sample data delivery (by Mon). Renewal signal: pilot satisfaction + DAU adoption. If either below threshold at week 4 we escalate.

Maya Singh (Willowbrook): Will upload 2k sample docs by Mon EOD and confirm infra lead. Thanks all.

Rafael Ortiz: Will post firewall snippet and capacity estimate after samples.

Ivy Chen: I'll post a 0-30 owner timeline here before EOD.
